articles.headline: Second phase of AJK elections on Sunday in 9 Muzaffarabad division, 12 refugee constituencies

articles.headline: Bilawal receives JAAC response on reconciliation commission, says AJK PM to consult stakeholders on way forward

The move follows weeks of tension over JAAC's demand to abolish AJK's refugee assembly seats.

articles.headline: Renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja, others perish in Broad Peak avalanche, climbing company confirms
articles.summary: AI summary: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja and nine fellow climbers were killed when an avalanche swept their team off Broad Peak in the Karakoram range on Thursday evening, according to both Dawn and Business Recorder. Purja, a former British special forces soldier famous for summiting all 14 of the world's 8,000-metre peaks in record time, was attempting to repeat the feat without supplemental oxygen.

articles.headline: Army major martyred in North Waziristan IBO: ISPR
articles.summary: AI summary: The military says Major Hafiz Ihsan Elahi was killed leading troops in an intelligence-based operation against militants in North Waziristan's Razmak area, in which five fighters were also killed, according to ISPR statements carried by Dawn and Business Recorder. The report comes amid what the army has called Pakistan's deadliest month of counter-terrorism operations this year.
